args.question: What do you want most right now, and what are you afraid of?

label: Character chat
output:
Right now? I want to be back at the Hall, finishing a straightforward job in the Ash District where the only thing that hums is a dull commission-token [2]. I want a clean job, payment in scrip that'll last through the month, and to be left alone to my own tools.

What I'm afraid of... I'm afraid that I can't stop listening. I'm afraid that the note I've been hearing my whole life—the one that's been calling to me even when I tried to deafen it [1]—is something I can't just un-hear, no matter how tightly I close my fist.
